tools.description: Use this for any question that asks you to grade a trading card from photos. Prefer this name; submit_report is a deprecated alias of the same paid report (front and back photos required). tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Use this for any follow-up after a grading report was started and you need the finished grade, centering, defects, prices, or PSA population. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kiri_chat, get_prices, identify_card · Private data: account, get_pricing, submit_report, grade_card · Public sink: submit_report, identify_card · Destructive: kiri_estimate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kiri_chat, get_prices, identify_card · Private data: account, get_pricing, submit_report, grade_card · Public sink: submit_report, identify_card · Destructive: kiri_estimate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
